label: Every maximum in being is GOD_2 over the reduced naming: certified difference
note: Difference of 'every maximum in being is GOD_2' and the reduced nominal description: the strong version adds exactly that every maximum in being that does not both cause the being of every other being and be the only maximum is GOD_2. The delta concerns only maxima outside the reduced description, including the case of several maxima, which the at-most-one-maximum result addresses separately. The two-maxima separator is a finite interpretation, not a claim that several maxima in being exist.
